svg.title: Claude Assassin — How It Works Infographic
svg.desc: Visual overview of the claude-assassin skill: session limit hits, state is saved, daemon schedules resume, Claude relaunches automatically.
svg.text: Install once. Works forever. No babysitting required.

g.text: Task in progress · files open · context loaded

task resumes exactly where it stopped

g.text: One-time install · zero maintenance · silent assassin
